extensionDescription.message: Finds sustained tab resource-growth patterns, explains local evidence, and lets you review safe recovery actions.

errorExtensionDidNotRespond.message: Tab Leak Guard did not respond.

permissionCardDescription.message: Grant website access to monitor regular websites, or start a private 15-minute session for this tab.

localAnalysisFooter.message: Local analysis · no browsing data sent

monitoringPausedDescription.message: No collectors are running. Earlier local findings may still appear.

manualMonitoringDescription.message: Toolbar scans run only for the current tab and stop after 15 minutes.

permissionNeededDescription.message: Continuous monitoring is selected, but Firefox has not granted website access.

monitoringOneSelectedSiteDescription.message: Firefox currently allows continuous monitoring on 1 selected site.

monitoringSelectedSitesDescription.message: Firefox currently allows continuous monitoring on $1 selected sites.

monitoringAllSitesDescription.message: Eligible HTTP and HTTPS tabs are monitored locally.

monitoringSummaryChanged.message: Monitoring updated: $1 likely runaway, $2 elevated, and $3 other monitored.

noMonitoredTabsDescription.message: Start a 15-minute session or enable continuous monitoring.

temporarySessionExpired.message: Temporary session ending; start another session for fresh evidence.

snoozedSuccess.message: Recovery suggestions for this tab are snoozed for 30 minutes.

errorTabNoLongerMonitored.message: The tab is no longer monitored.

recoveryCancelled.message: Recovery was cancelled. No tab action ran.

errorWebsiteAccessNotGranted.message: Firefox did not grant website access. Manual 15-minute sessions are still available.

continuousMonitoringActiveForTab.message: Continuous monitoring is active for this tab.

temporaryMonitoringStarted.message: Temporary monitoring started for $1 minutes. You can stop it at any time.

collectingEvidence.message: Collecting enough evidence to establish a baseline.

evidenceReasonUnavailable.message: Evidence changed; open details to review its stable reason code.

reasonNotEnoughSamples.message: More distinct samples are needed before drawing a conclusion.

reasonDomGrowth.message: The live DOM grew substantially from its settled baseline.

reasonDomSlope.message: Live DOM growth remained positive over the longer evidence window.

reasonRecentDomSlope.message: Live DOM growth is continuing in recent samples.

reasonSustainedRetention.message: Added DOM nodes are being retained instead of released.

reasonSevereDomPattern.message: A large, sustained retained-DOM growth pattern is present.

reasonResourceActivity.message: Resource activity increased; this is context, not a memory measurement.

reasonResponsivenessContext.message: Visible responsiveness slowed; this supports but cannot prove a leak.

reasonDomRelease.message: The page released DOM nodes, reducing concern.

reasonVirtualizedChurn.message: High DOM churn is being released, which resembles a virtualized interface.

reasonConfirmationInProgress.message: Strong evidence is present but must persist across more time and samples.

reasonQualitySampleGaps.message: Sampling gaps lower confidence in this finding.

reasonQualityDomPartial.message: Live-DOM evidence was unavailable for part of this window.

reasonQualityLargeGap.message: A long pause or sleep gap lowers evidence quality.

reasonQualityOverflow.message: The collector reached a bounded work limit, lowering evidence quality.

reasonQualityDroppedEntries.message: Some performance entries were dropped, lowering contextual signal quality.

reasonQualityCollectorDegraded.message: The collector reduced work to protect page performance.

reasonQualityStale.message: The newest evidence is too old to authorize recovery.

reasonQualityClock.message: Document timing was not monotonic, so the evidence was segmented.

reasonQualityResourceUnavailable.message: Resource-activity context is unavailable; it does not add confidence.

reasonQualityResponsivenessPartial.message: Responsiveness context is incomplete and cannot add confidence.

acknowledgeEditRisk.message: I understand that edited or unsaved page state may be lost.

unloadEffect.message: Firefox will keep the tab in the tab strip, release its loaded page, and restore it when you select it.

reloadEffect.message: Firefox will reload this active tab with the normal browser cache. Website state that has not been saved may be lost.

recoveryStateMayBeLost.message: Page state that the website has not saved may be lost.

acknowledgementRequired.message: Acknowledge the edited or unknown page-state warning before continuing.

unloadCompleted.message: The tab was unloaded and will restore when selected.

recoveryConfirmationExpires.message: This exact action authorization expires in $1.

recoveryExpiresSoon.message: This recovery authorization expires in about 10 seconds.

recoveryPreparationExpired.message: The recovery review expired. No tab action ran; review the current state again.

recoveryStateChanged.message: The tab or finding changed after recovery was prepared. No action ran; review it again.

warningReloadState.message: Reloading can lose page state that the website has not saved.

warningUnloadRestore.message: Unloading keeps the tab in the tab strip and reloads it when selected.

warningEditedInput.message: Edited input was observed in this document.

warningUnknownInput.message: Tab Leak Guard cannot confirm whether this document contains edited input.

warningSafetyUnavailable.message: Some current tab safety signals are unavailable.

warningTabAudio.message: This tab is currently playing audio.

warningTabAttention.message: This tab is requesting your attention.

warningTabSharing.message: This tab is currently sharing media or your screen.

warningFullscreen.message: The tab’s browser window is fullscreen.

warningFirefoxProtected.message: Firefox marks this tab as protected from automatic unloading.

settingsSubheading.message: Conservative defaults, local analysis, and controls you can reverse.

websiteAccessDescription.message: Optional access lets a small local collector run on regular HTTP and HTTPS pages. Manual 15-minute sessions work without broad access.

monitorContinuouslyDescription.message: Sample eligible tabs only while permission is granted.

systemNotificationsDescription.message: The toolbar badge remains available when notifications are off.

automaticRecoveryUnavailable.message: Automatic recovery is hidden and unavailable while its safety gates are being validated. Every unload or reload requires your review.

quietPeriod.message: Quiet period before recovery is suggested

settingsSavedPermissionNeeded.message: Settings saved. Grant website access before continuous monitoring can start.

allSiteScopeDescription.message: Firefox allows Tab Leak Guard to monitor regular HTTP and HTTPS pages. Internal and restricted pages remain unavailable.

permissionStoredManualDescription.message: Firefox still stores website access, but Tab Leak Guard is in manual mode and is not using it for continuous monitoring.

oneSelectedSiteScopeDescription.message: Firefox allows continuous monitoring on 1 selected site.

selectedSiteScopeDescription.message: Firefox allows continuous monitoring on $1 selected sites.

manualScopeDescription.message: No broad website access is stored. Start temporary sessions from the toolbar as needed.

websiteAccessRemoved.message: Website access was removed and continuous collectors were stopped.

websitePermissionStillGranted.message: Firefox still grants website access. Retry, or remove it in Firefox Add-ons Manager.

selectedSitesHeading.message: Limit continuous monitoring to selected sites

selectedSitesDescription.message: Add an HTTP or HTTPS site. Firefox will show a permission prompt for that exact origin, and other sites stay manual-only.

removeAllSiteBeforeSelected.message: Remove all-site access above before switching to a smaller selected-site permission.

selectedSitePrivacyGuidance.message: Only origins listed here are eligible for continuous collection. HTTP and HTTPS are separate Firefox permissions.

invalidSiteAddress.message: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS site address, such as https://example.com.

selectedSitePermissionDenied.message: Firefox did not grant access to that selected site.

selectedSitePermissionStillGranted.message: Firefox still grants access to $1. Retry, or remove it in Firefox Add-ons Manager.

sitePolicyDescription.message: Ignoring a site stops its collectors and removes its current findings. Monitoring, notifications, and future recovery permission are stored as separate policies.

siteMonitoringRestored.message: $1 will use the current monitoring scope again.

noSiteOverrides.message: No separate site policies. Global defaults apply.

policyRecoveryAllowFuture.message: eligible for a future opt-in recovery feature

receiptDescription.message: A local record of requested outcomes—not an estimate of recovered memory.

phaseCancelled.message: Cancelled before a tab action was requested.

phaseExpired.message: Authorization expired before a tab action was requested.

phaseBlocked.message: A current safety or browser check blocked the action.

phaseRequestFailed.message: Firefox rejected or failed the requested tab action.

phaseRequested.message: The request was journaled; whether Firefox accepted or completed it is unknown.

phaseCompleted.message: The requested tab action was verified as complete.

phaseVerificationTimedOut.message: Firefox accepted the request, but completion could not be verified in time.

observedDescription.message: Live DOM growth, mutation retention, resource activity, visible responsiveness, tab state, and an edited-input state—not the input itself.

neverReadDescription.message: Form values, page text, cookies, request bodies, browsing history, screenshots, or account identifiers.

notAvailableDescription.message: Exact per-tab memory, detached-DOM size, pure JavaScript heap usage, GPU memory, and Firefox internal pages.

localOnlyPrivacy.message: Findings and receipts stay in Firefox extension storage. Notification text is generic by default so a lock screen does not reveal the site.

localDataControlsDescription.message: Export a redacted diagnostic file for troubleshooting, or delete settings, findings, receipts, and pending actions from extension storage.

diagnosticsExported.message: A redacted diagnostic file was created. It excludes titles, hostnames, page text, and form values.

deleteEverythingStored.message: Delete everything stored by Tab Leak Guard?

deleteEverythingDescription.message: This removes settings, findings, receipts, site policies, snoozes, and pending recovery actions. Firefox website permissions are managed separately and are not removed.

deleteAcknowledgement.message: I understand that this local extension data cannot be restored.

allLocalDataDeleted.message: All local extension data was deleted. Firefox website permissions were left unchanged and can be removed above.

welcomeHeading.message: Spot sustained tab growth before it takes over Firefox.

welcomeDescription.message: Tab Leak Guard learns a page’s normal behavior, looks for sustained resource-growth patterns, and explains evidence it can observe. It does not measure exact memory.

manualOnlyChoiceDescription.message: Start a private 15-minute session from the toolbar on a regular website.

selectedSiteChoiceDescription.message: Grant continuous access to one exact HTTP or HTTPS origin. Add more later in settings.

allSitesChoiceDescription.message: Ask Firefox for optional HTTP and HTTPS access and monitor eligible tabs continuously.

onboardingSafetyNote.message: Recovery is notify-only. Automatic recovery is unavailable while safety validation is in progress.

toolbarGuidance.message: Pin Tab Leak Guard to the Firefox toolbar to start sessions and review findings quickly.

observeTrendsDescription.message: Tracks live DOM retention, resource activity, and responsiveness. It never reads page text or form values.

requireEvidenceDescription.message: Builds a baseline for about five minutes and looks for sustained growth—not one large page update.

reviewRecoveryDescription.message: Prepares an exact unload or reload action, checks the current page again, and asks for your consent.

limitationDescription.message: Firefox does not expose exact per-tab memory to standard extensions. Tab Leak Guard reports possible retained-DOM growth patterns and clearly marks missing or stale evidence.

permissionDeniedManualAvailable.message: Firefox did not grant website access. Choose Manual only to continue without broad access.

setupAllSitesDescription.message: Continuous local monitoring is enabled for regular websites. Findings need several minutes of evidence, and every recovery action still requires your review.

setupSelectedSiteDescription.message: Continuous local monitoring is enabled only for $1. Other sites remain manual-only, and every recovery action requires your review.

setupManualDescription.message: Manual mode is ready. Open the toolbar button on a regular website to start a private 15-minute monitoring session.
